lead_independence.headline: Stuart man arrested after using PIT maneuver on family's SUV in Martin County road rage attack
lead_independence.lead: Michael Jeffrey Spiers, 36, was arrested Saturday after deputies say he used a PIT maneuver to send a family's SUV into a barbed-wire fence near Kanner Highway and I-95. The Martin County Sheriff's Office said the crash happened around 7:30 p.m. Spiers is charged with aggravated battery with a deadly weapon and child abuse. Deputies said the family had no role in any confrontation before they were targeted.
